title: Ohio Infusion Drug Markup Audit

required_inputs.label: NADAC
required_inputs.purpose: Public drug acquisition-cost reference; not plan reimbursement

required_inputs.label: Medicare Part B drug spending
required_inputs.purpose: Rank drugs by spend and select the configured top set

supplemental_inputs.label: Manual unit reviews
supplemental_inputs.purpose: Reviewer sign-off for selected drug billing units

method_notes: A published hospital rate is not an employer claim or a utilization-weighted plan cost.
A unit error can create a false markup; each included drug requires manual unit review before external use.
Hospital acquisition cost is not observed. 340B discounts do not determine the amount an employer plan pays.
Site-of-care changes require a lower-cost in-network option, clinical suitability, and the treating clinician's agreement.

status_notes.review_range: Outside the configured review range; inspect before drawing a conclusion.
status_notes.unit_unresolved: Unit could not be established; excluded from the headline comparison.
status_notes.missing_asp: No ASP payment limit is loaded for the hospital file's quarter; no price comparison was calculated.
status_notes.unit_ambiguous: More than one unit interpretation is plausible; excluded from the headline comparison.
status_notes.algorithm_only: Contract algorithm or terms are present instead of a negotiated dollar amount.
status_notes.not_drug_price: The row was excluded as not representing a drug price.
